verdict.rationale: Anytype's developer docs say the Anytype CLI can run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting, which covers the core of the story. Supporting evidence shows a local API and an agents skill that runs scripts against Anytype data programmatically. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on CI-specific setup (auth/key provisioning in non-interactive environments, containerized headless client usage), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the headless CLI works in CI pipelines.
